propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has built merge-rule and consent-flag changes at a marketing software company's customer data platform for three years from the data product managers' design notes, with thirty-nine pull requests merged in his name, each shipped behind a canary with the canary result attached.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the pull requests document the work and the canary results.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate sat down with the marketing and support product managers before each rollout under the rollout communication standard with their acknowledgement linked from each pull request, and rolled out on the platform lead's approval with the check split recorded.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the session notes and the reference call document the sessions and the approval boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In the panel exercise the candidate explained a sample merge-rule change with one customer record as the example, showing which records would merge and which would stay separate, naming the support screen where the change would appear, and giving the number of records touched on day one.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the rollout communication requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: The pull requests carry the change boundaries, but the boundaries for the consent changes of the last quarter are not in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one exercise; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the pull requests of the last quarter's consent changes.
